outcome: Refactor ExHarness CI into an agent-native delivery feedback plane: verification execution must produce exact candidate-bound observations and evidence that delivery agents can consume for repair, selective re-verification, semantic supervision and delivery, while GitHub checks remain transport projections rather than domain authority.
currentProblem: The current CI surface is split across GitHub workflow conditions, JEV-specific scripts, repository verification commands and delivery scripts. PR/check status, skip semantics and commit/head identity can leak into control decisions, which makes CI behave like a human merge gate instead of an execution/feedback substrate for autonomous delivery. ExHarness needs one delivery-loop contract from Work/Attempt/Candidate through verification observations, failure classification, repair/retry and JEV to delivery.
constraints: RESEARCH_SA first: opening BB-158 grants no CI implementation authority. Research must close with a fresh exact READY plan and independent JEV satisfaction before Worker mutation.

Blackboard V2 Work generation, Attempt, candidate/evidence identities and Decisions are canonical control authority; PR numbers, workflow names, check conclusions and branch-protection state are adapter metadata only.
CI is an execution and feedback plane, not an independent source of Work lifecycle truth or correctness authority.
Deterministic verifiers and semantic supervisors may publish into one typed observation/evidence model, but their authority classes remain distinct; JEV stays independent semantic supervision.
Every observation must bind the exact Work generation, Attempt and candidate/evidence subject it evaluated. Stale or superseded results fail closed and cannot advance delivery.
Retry is driven by failure class, material candidate/evidence delta and explicit retry policy, never by blind rerun-until-green behavior.
Progressive/early failure may cancel irrelevant downstream execution, but emitted evidence and accounting must remain truthful about completed, partial, cancelled and unavailable work.
GitHub Actions is one execution adapter. The contract must remain usable by local or future CI runtimes without re-defining delivery semantics.
successCriteria: Audit every current CI/delivery verification path and identify where GitHub transport state, JEV state, deterministic verification and Blackboard lifecycle currently overlap or contradict.
Define one typed, immutable verification observation/evidence contract bound to exact Work generation, Attempt, candidate and verifier subject, including failure classification and freshness.
Define an agent control loop for progressive verification, early failure, diagnosis/repair, material-delta retry, selective re-verification, JEV supervision and convergence to delivery readiness.

Define fail-closed semantics for stale observations, verifier/infra failure, flaky suspicion, partial/cancelled runs and insufficient evidence without converting those states into product correctness claims.
Define the GitHub Actions adapter boundary so required checks/statuses are projections of canonical delivery state rather than inputs that create canonical state.
Produce a bounded implementation decomposition, negative cases, benchmark/evaluation plan and Living Docs impact ready for independent JEV review.
